name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset
description:
Authors Verse fields on a Widget Blueprint and binds widget properties to them via MVVM. Covers
listing, adding, editing, removing, and duplicating fields, plus creating the view binding that
drives a widget property from a field's value.

tools.description: Removes a Verse field by name. Recompiles. Not supported during PIE.
tools.name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.RemoveVerseField

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

fieldName.description: Name of the field to remove.

returnValue.description: True on success; false with a script error on failure.

tools.description: Lists the Verse-authored fields on a Widget Blueprint.
tools.name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.ListVerseFields

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

defaultValue.description: usually one of bool/int/float/string/color/color_alpha/texture/material/message/event; an unrecognized pin type falls back to UE's raw pin-category name

eventParameterTypes.description: For an event field (bIsEvent=true), the ordered parameter types ("bool"/"int"/"float"). Empty otherwise or for a parameterless event.

returnValue.description: One entry per Verse field (name, type keyword, default, access, mutability).

tools.description:
Accepted Spec.Type / Spec.EventParameterTypes values. Query this instead of assuming a fixed
list -- it reads from the same place the validation does.
tools.name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.GetSupportedVerseFieldTypes

eventParameterTypes.description: Every value FVerseFieldSpec::EventParameterTypes accepts (only relevant when Type is "event").

tools.description: Edits an existing Verse field (retype/default/access/mutability). Recompiles. Not supported during PIE.
tools.name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.EditVerseField

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

fieldName.description: Name of the existing field to edit.

spec.title: VerseFieldSpec
spec.description: Describes the field's new state (type, optional event parameters, default, access, mutability).

type.description: Query GetSupportedVerseFieldTypes for the current list of accepted values (e.g. bool, int, float, event, ...).

eventParameterTypes.description:
Only valid when Type is "event" -- ordered parameter types, see GetSupportedVerseFieldTypes().
Must be empty otherwise. Subject to VerseTypeEditor.EnableEventsCreation and
VerseTypeEditor.MaxEventParametersNumberCreation.

defaultValue.description: Optional string default (empty for none). Must be empty when Type is "event".

writeAccess.description:
Verse write access as a specifier string: "" inherits Visibility; otherwise one of
"<public>", "<internal>", "<protected>", "<private>", "<scoped>".

newName.description: When non-empty, renames the field to this name.

returnValue.description: True on success; false with a script error on failure.

tools.description: Duplicates a Verse field under a new name. Recompiles. Not supported during PIE.
tools.name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.DuplicateVerseField

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

fieldName.description: Name of the existing field to duplicate.

newName.description: Name for the duplicated field. Required: must be non-empty and not already in use on the blueprint. The duplicate is named exactly this; an empty or colliding name fails with a script error.

returnValue.description: True on success; false with a script error on failure.

tools.description:
Binds a widget property to a Verse field on the same Widget Blueprint (the field is the MVVM SelfContext
source). Creates the view binding and applies the requested mode; recompiles. Not supported during PIE.
tools.name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.BindWidgetPropertyToVerseField

widgetBlueprint.title: /Script/UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprint
widgetBlueprint.description: Target widget blueprint (must already contain VerseFieldName).

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

verseFieldName.description: Existing Verse field to read from.

targetWidget.title: /Script/UMG.Widget
targetWidget.description: Widget in the tree whose property is written.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

widgetPropertyPath.description: Dot-path to the destination property (e.g. "RenderOpacity", "ColorAndOpacity.SpecifiedColor"). Case-sensitive.

mode.title: EMVVMBindingMode
mode.description: Binding mode (default OneWayToDestination = Verse field drives the widget; TwoWay for editable write-back).

conversionName.description: Optional conversion function name for type mismatches (None = auto).

returnValue.description: Valid binding FGuid on success; invalid FGuid with a script error on failure.

tools.description:
Adds a new Verse field (variable) to a Widget Blueprint. The field becomes bindable (FieldNotify) and
is reflected into the widget's generated Verse class. Recompiles the blueprint. Not supported during PIE.
tools.name: VerseFieldsToolset.VerseFieldsToolset.AddVerseField

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

fieldName.description: Name of the new field. Must be a valid identifier and unique on the blueprint.

spec.title: VerseFieldSpec
spec.description: Describes the field to add (type, optional event parameters, default, access, mutability).

type.description: Query GetSupportedVerseFieldTypes for the current list of accepted values (e.g. bool, int, float, event, ...).

eventParameterTypes.description:
Only valid when Type is "event" -- ordered parameter types, see GetSupportedVerseFieldTypes().
Must be empty otherwise. Subject to VerseTypeEditor.EnableEventsCreation and
VerseTypeEditor.MaxEventParametersNumberCreation.

defaultValue.description: Optional string default (empty for none). Must be empty when Type is "event".

writeAccess.description:
Verse write access as a specifier string: "" inherits Visibility; otherwise one of
"<public>", "<internal>", "<protected>", "<private>", "<scoped>".

returnValue.description: True on success; false with a script error on failure.
